# 1. Listen to admins and leadership The admins are here to enforce rules which keep the game enjoyable for everyone. If you find an admins actions unfair then please contact the host/owner about the issue. Rules may need to be interpreted by the admins at times for what they believe is best for the server.
Any in-character leadership that you are under the command of must have their orders followed. You are allowed to question orders and can only deny orders if they are not possible, are against rules, dont make sense or if you have a very good reason to.
